pages.text: Energy flows, but materials still need manual carrying? Time to let them move on their own.$(br2)Item Pipes form $(bold)logistics networks$(): connect chests and machines, and items are automatically moved from sources to sinks.

Four tiers of pipes, higher tiers transfer more items per tick:$(li)$(bold)Basic$(): 1 item/tick$(li)$(bold)Intermediate$(): 4 items/tick$(li)$(bold)Advanced$(): 16 items/tick$(li)$(bold)Ultimate$(): 64 items/tick$(br2)Network throughput equals the sum of all pipe rates, scheduled by the representative node (the pipe with the smallest coordinates).
Basic Item Pipe: Gold Ingot + Glass + Chishi Crystal, crafts 8 at a time.
Intermediate / Advanced pipes are upgraded from lower tiers; the Ultimate pipe also needs Condensed Chishi Essence Blocks.

$(bold)Smart connection$():$(li)Vanilla containers (chests etc.): all slots act as both input and output$(li)Chishi machines (Purifier, Aggregator, etc.): precise input / output per internal definition$(li)Auto Collector: all 27 slots flow$(br2)$(bold)Configurator$(): right-click to cycle Normal / Push / Pull, sneak + right-click to disconnect a face - the same tool used for Energy Pipes.

pages.title: Chishi Configurator
pages.text: One tool controls both energy and logistics.
